title: Analytic: in-plane electric dipole, H1 near field and sin^2 far field (H_z, Ricker pulse)
description:
An in-plane electric dipole (H_z point_source, excitation electric_dipole, strength M = 1 mA) in a CPML-bounded vacuum box (FDTD), its current tilted by alpha = 30.17 deg (atan(25/43), so the on-axis probe sits exactly on a cell-centre line through the source). Two physics on one mesh: 'em_cw' drives it cw at lambda0 = 1 um (near-field probes), 'em_pulse' with a Ricker wavelet peaked at lambda0 (far_field box at lambda0).
Analytic: |H_z| = (k M / 4) |H1^(2)(k r)| |sin(phi - alpha)| (H1^(2) = J1 - j Y1); the far-field pattern is sin^2(angle - alpha) at every wavelength, so the broadband Ricker pulse gives the same pattern as cw: nulls along the current (alpha, alpha + 180 deg), lobes broadside.
Probes tab: em_cw.probe_broad (r = 0.995 um, phi = alpha + 90 deg) between the dashed +-H_amp lines; em_cw.probe_axis (phi = alpha) stays near 0.
Derived values tab: H_broad (steady peak over the last 3 periods) vs H_amp, H_axis_ratio (on-axis peak / H_amp, reference 0, absolute), null_far and half_far (peak-normalised far-field power at alpha and alpha + 45 deg: 0 and 0.5).
Far field tab: em_pulse.far vs the dashed sin^2(angle - alpha) (both peak-normalised).
Expected agreement: ~1-3 % on H_broad (finite four-face dipole, discrete dispersion, CPML), < 1e-2 on the null and the pattern; to be confirmed by a first run.

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: cw wavelength and Ricker peak wavelength (50 cells)

parameters.name: M_dip
parameters.description: dipole strength M [A] (current moment per unit z length)

parameters.name: alpha_deg
parameters.description: dipole orientation [deg] counter-clockwise from +x: 30.17 deg, the direction of the on-axis probe

parameters.name: x_broad_prb
parameters.description: broadside probe x (a cell centre; offset rotated by +90 deg)

parameters.name: r_prb
parameters.description: distance of both probes to the dipole (0.995 um)

parameters.name: T_steady
parameters.description: start of the window (last 3 periods) whose peak |H_z| is the steady amplitude
